concept.title: Dawn Walk Round Pine Valley
concept.logline: On overcast, epic Renkelvale, you wander far to recover the seed relics and restore the Moon Shrine.
concept.source_prompt: Pine Valley. forest woods pine valley exploration Grand tour
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Mossbrook Camp and becomes the one who brings the Moon Shrine back to life.

characters.description: Waits in Mossbrook Camp and knows why the Moon Shrine fell silent.

characters.name: Bram the Scout
characters.description: Follows you from Mossbrook Camp and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Thorn Wolf
characters.description: A thorn wolf that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Corin the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Renkelvale for anything shiny.

characters.name: Moss Hare
characters.description: A harmless moss hare that bolts if you come too close.

actions.value: On overcast, epic Renkelvale, you wander far to recover the seed relics and restore the Moon Shrine.
Explore all 5 corners of Dawn Walk Round Pine Valley, in any order, then head home.
You reach the Beaver Dam Jetty.
Home again, with the whole map in your head.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Elder Hale
nodes.text: So you've come to Mossbrook Camp at last. I am Elder Hale. On overcast, epic Renkelvale, you wander far to recover the seed relics and restore the Moon Shrine.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Elder Hale
nodes.text: Back again. Mossbrook Camp is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Elder Hale
nodes.text: Go to Beaver Dam Jetty, then Woodcutter Camp. Whatever still remembers Dawn Walk Round Pine Valley is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Elder Hale
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Mossbrook Camp, Dawn Walk Round Pine Valley was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Serene, even then.

choices.text: Tell me about Beaver Dam Jetty.

nodes.speaker: Elder Hale
nodes.text: Beaver Dam Jetty: Beaver Dam Jetty: a dock on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

nodes.speaker: Elder Hale
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Dawn Walk Round Pine Valley back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Elder Hale
nodes.text: Woodcutter Camp: Woodcutter Camp: a camp on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Scout
nodes.text: Bram the Scout circles your feet, then looks toward Moon Shrine as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Scout
nodes.text: Bram the Scout sniffs the air. Something about Moon Shrine has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Scout
nodes.text: It turns toward Moon Shrine. Moon Shrine: the far end of the grand loop, where the story ends.

nodes.speaker: Thorn Wolf
nodes.text: The thorn wolf watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Mossbrook Camp. Corin the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Dawn Walk Round Pine Valley that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Great Stump after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Moss Hare
nodes.text: The moss hare freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
